acceptance: `make uat-bring-up PLATFORM=doris` and `PLATFORM=singlestore` start healthy stacks under mocker 0.7.x.
The declared-settings probe passes on both.
description:
#3998 made bring-up detect and fail loudly when mocker drops a compose stack's entrypoint, memory, ulimit or platform setting. The stacks still cannot start through compose on macOS. Doris needed `mocker run -m 4g --entrypoint bash` with the repo's entrypoint script. SingleStore needed `mocker run --platform linux/amd64 -m 4g -c 4`. Every live check on these engines needs hand-written commands.

Change. Give bring-up an engine-aware launch for mocker (for example translating the compose service into the mocker run flags that work), so `make uat-bring-up PLATFORM=doris|singlestore` starts a healthy stack on macOS. Keep the loud failure for settings that still cannot be applied.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
